title: Causal forests versus penalized splines for heterogeneous treatment effects
title_zh: 异质性处理效应下因果森林与惩罚样条方法的比较
title_primary: 异质性处理效应下因果森林与惩罚样条方法的比较
title_secondary: Causal forests versus penalized splines for heterogeneous treatment effects
authors: Ivan Korolev, Abiodun Musbaudeen, Nency Dhameja
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper compares causal forests with varying-coefficient penalized spline estimators for heterogeneous treatment effects. We conduct simulations with randomized treatment assignment that vary heterogeneity, predictor dimension, and discrete nuisance structure. Performance is measured by out-of-sample mean squared error. Forests perform best in Wager–Athey designs with sharp treatment-effect transitions. Penalized splines tend to dominate when heterogeneity is smooth, when the baseline mean and treatment effect differ in structure, and in mixed designs with continuous, binary, and group-level covariates. As group cardinality rises, forest performance deteriorates, while mgcv random-effect smooths handle group structure effectively and remain easy to implement.
abstract_zh: 本文比较了因果森林与变系数惩罚样条估计器在异质性处理效应中的表现。我们通过随机化处理分配的模拟实验，变化异质性程度、预测变量维度及离散干扰结构。性能以样本外均方误差衡量。在Wager–Athey设计中，处理效应转变陡峭时，森林方法表现最佳。当异质性平滑、基线均值与处理效应结构不同，以及混合设计包含连续、二元和组级协变量时，惩罚样条通常占优。随着组基数增大，森林性能下降，而mgcv随机效应平滑能有效处理组结构，且易于实施。

title: A Macroeconomic Model of Healthcare Saturation, Inequality & the Output-Pandemia Tradeoff
title_zh: 医疗饱和、不平等与产出-大流行病权衡的宏观经济模型
title_primary: 医疗饱和、不平等与产出-大流行病权衡的宏观经济模型
title_secondary: A Macroeconomic Model of Healthcare Saturation, Inequality & the Output-Pandemia Tradeoff
authors: Enrique Mendoza, Eugenio Rojas, Linda Tesar
official: 官方在线 2021-02-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: COVID-19 became a global health emergency when it threatened the catastrophic collapse of health systems as demand for health goods and services and their relative prices surged. Governments responded with lockdowns and increases in transfers. Empirical evidence shows that lockdowns and healthcare saturation contribute to explain the cross-country variation in GDP drops even after controlling for COVID-19 cases and mortality. We explain this output-pandemia tradeoff as resulting from a shock to subsistence health demand that is larger at higher capital utilization in a model with entrepreneurs and workers. The health system moves closer to saturation as the gap between supply and subsistence narrows, which worsens consumption and income inequality. An externality distorts utilization, because firms do not internalize that lower utilization relaxes healthcare saturation. The optimal policy response includes lockdowns and transfers to workers. Quantitatively, strict lockdowns and large transfer hikes can be optimal and yield sizable welfare gains because they prevent a sharp rise in inequality. Welfare and output costs vary in response to small parameter changes or deviations from optimal policies. Weak lockdowns coupled with weak transfers programs are the worst alternative and yet are in line with what several emerging and least developed countries have implemented.
abstract_zh: COVID-19成为全球卫生紧急事件，因为随着健康商品和服务的需求及其相对价格飙升，卫生系统面临灾难性崩溃的威胁。各国政府以封锁和增加转移支付作为应对措施。经验证据表明，即使在控制COVID-19病例数和死亡率之后，封锁和医疗系统饱和也有助于解释各国GDP下降的差异。我们在一个包含企业家和工人的模型中，将这种产出与大流行的权衡解释为源于生存性健康需求的冲击，该冲击在资本利用率更高时更大。随着供给与生存需求之间的差距缩小，卫生系统更接近饱和，这加剧了消费和收入不平等。一种外部性扭曲了利用率，因为企业没有内化较低的利用率会缓解医疗系统饱和这一事实。最优政策应对包括封锁和对工人的转移支付。定量分析显示，严格的封锁和大规模转移支付增加可能是最优的，并能带来可观的福利收益，因为它们防止了不平等的急剧上升。福利和产出成本会因参数的小幅变化或偏离最优政策而产生差异。弱封锁配合弱转移支付计划是最差的选择，然而这正是若干新兴经济体和最不发达国家所实施的政策。

title: Trust beyond borders: the role of non-state actors in shaping immigration preferences
title_zh: 跨越边界的信任：非国家行为体在塑造移民偏好中的作用
title_primary: 跨越边界的信任：非国家行为体在塑造移民偏好中的作用
title_secondary: Trust beyond borders: the role of non-state actors in shaping immigration preferences
authors: Annette Idler, Isabel Ruiz, Carlos Vargas-Silva
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Evidence for high-income countries suggests that higher levels of political trust, defined as confidence in state actors, are associated with greater openness to immigration. We argue that in contexts of weak state governance, trust in non-state actors, such as the church or international organizations, may also be relevant. To examine this, we conduct face-to-face surveys, each including a conjoint experiment, in three border locations experiencing large inflows of Venezuelans: Boa Vista (Brazil), Cúcuta (Colombia), and San Fernando (Trinidad and Tobago). The results indicate that higher levels of trust in international organizations, particularly UNHCR, are associated with lower preferences for community profiles with a closed door to immigration. These findings point to the importance of a more nuanced conceptualization of trust that includes non-state actors when examining public attitudes toward immigration in settings of weak state governance. They also highlight the value of moving beyond national-level or state-centric analyses toward approaches that are more sensitive to local governance contexts. Finally, the results are consistent with the view that, in such regions, international organizations are perceived as trusted intermediaries in relation to immigration attitudes.
abstract_zh: 针对高收入国家的证据表明，政治信任（定义为对国家行为体的信心）水平越高，对移民的开放程度也越高。我们认为，在国家治理薄弱的情境下，对非国家行为体（如教会或国际组织）的信任也可能具有相关性。为考察这一问题，我们在三个面临大量委内瑞拉移民涌入的边境地区——博阿维斯塔（巴西）、库库塔（哥伦比亚）和圣费尔南多（特立尼达和多巴哥）——开展了面对面调查，每项调查均包含一个联合实验。结果表明，对国际组织（尤其是联合国难民署）信任度较高的受访者，对采取封闭移民政策的社区形象的偏好较低。这些发现表明，在研究国家治理薄弱情境下公众对移民的态度时，有必要对信任进行更为细致的概念化，将非国家行为体纳入考量。同时，研究也凸显了超越国家层面或国家中心主义分析、转向更贴近地方治理情境的研究路径的价值。最后，研究结果与以下观点一致：在此类地区，国际组织被视为与移民态度相关的可信中介。

title: Spanish Labour Market, Mobility and Labour Shortages
title_zh: 西班牙劳动力市场、流动性与劳动力短缺
title_primary: 西班牙劳动力市场、流动性与劳动力短缺
title_secondary: Spanish Labour Market, Mobility and Labour Shortages
authors: Carlos Carrillo-Tudela, Alex Clymo, Cristina La Fuente, Ludo Visschers, David Zentler-Munro
official: 官方在线 2024-11-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We use a simple yet powerful approach to investigate the dynamics of worker flows across sectors in the Spanish economy. The method imposes a minimal amount of structure on the data by assuming sector-specific matching functions, and backs out the direction of workers’ search intensities across sectors using data on realised worker flows and vacancies. We find that aggregate search intensity in Spain has been increasing since the pandemic and has led aggregate labour shortages to be below pre-pandemic levels by 2023. However, this boost of search intensity is directed to industries with low matching efficiencies and job finding rates. As a result, aggregate match formation is near to a 10-years low relative to the number of matches that would result if search intensity was allocated to maximise total matches given the observed vacancy distribution and match efficiencies across sectors.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种简洁而有力的方法来研究西班牙经济中跨部门工人流动的动态。该方法通过假设部门特定的匹配函数，对数据施加最小结构，并利用已实现的工人流动和职位空缺数据，反推出工人跨部门的搜寻强度方向。我们发现，自疫情以来，西班牙的总搜寻强度一直在上升，并导致截至2023年总劳动力短缺低于疫情前水平。然而，这种搜寻强度的提升主要流向匹配效率低和就业率低的行业。因此，相对于在观察到的职位空缺分布和各部门匹配效率下，若搜寻强度被分配以最大化总匹配数所能产生的结果，总匹配形成量接近十年来的低点。

title: Carbon Emissions and the Bank-Lending Channel
title_zh: 碳排放与银行信贷渠道
title_primary: 碳排放与银行信贷渠道
title_secondary: Carbon Emissions and the Bank-Lending Channel
authors: Marcin Kacperczyk, José-Luis Peydró
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how firm-level carbon emissions affect bank lending and real outcomes in a sample of global firms with syndicated loans. We exploit bank-level climate commitments as firm-level shocks to lending relationships, using firms' prior credit exposures to identify credit supply effects. Firms with higher emissions that previously borrowed from committed banks receive less bank credit. Evidence from lending volumes, prices, and within-firm-time loan-level data indicates a supply-side shift away from high-emission firms, not explained by borrower risk. Affected firms reduce debt, leverage, size, and investment, yet we find no reduction in future emissions, instead documenting evidence consistent with greenwashing. (JEL G21, G23, G30, D62, Q50)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在全球拥有银团贷款的企业样本中，企业层面的碳排放如何影响银行贷款及实际经营结果。我们利用银行层面的气候承诺作为企业层面贷款关系的冲击，通过企业以往的信贷敞口来识别信贷供给效应。先前从有承诺的银行借款的高排放企业，获得的银行信贷减少。来自贷款规模、价格以及企业-时间层面贷款数据的证据表明，信贷供给正从高排放企业转移，且这一现象并非由借款人风险解释。受影响的企业减少了债务、杠杆、规模和投资，但我们未发现其未来排放有所减少，反而记录了与“漂绿”行为一致的证据。(JEL G21, G23, G30, D62, Q50)

title: On competitive equilibria and cores in housing market problem with one broker
title_zh: 带一个中介人的住房市场问题中的竞争均衡与核
title_primary: 带一个中介人的住房市场问题中的竞争均衡与核
title_secondary: On competitive equilibria and cores in housing market problem with one broker
authors: Yu Gu, Yongchao Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the classical housing market problem, when all agents have strict preferences, Roth and Postlewaite (1977) show that the top trading cycles (TTC) mechanism yields the unique competitive equilibrium allocation and the unique strong core allocation. We study an extension of the housing market model that incorporates one broker. We propose the concepts of competitive equilibrium and strong core, and show that the outcome yielded by the trading cycles mechanism in Pycia and Ünver (2017) is the unique competitive equilibrium allocation and the unique strong core allocation.
abstract_zh: 在经典住房市场问题中，当所有代理具有严格偏好时，Roth和Postlewaite（1977）证明，顶级交易循环（TTC）机制产生唯一的竞争均衡配置和唯一的强核配置。我们研究了一个包含一个经纪人的住房市场模型的扩展。我们提出了竞争均衡和强核的概念，并证明Pycia和Ünver（2017）中的交易循环机制所产生的结果是唯一的竞争均衡配置和唯一的强核配置。

title: Fetal Pollution Exposure, Cognitive Ability, and Gender-specific Parental Investment
title_zh: 胎儿污染暴露、认知能力与性别差异化的父母投资
title_primary: 胎儿污染暴露、认知能力与性别差异化的父母投资
title_secondary: Fetal Pollution Exposure, Cognitive Ability, and Gender-specific Parental Investment
authors: Xin Zhang, Yixuan Wang, Xingyi Hu, Xi Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how prenatal exposure to air pollution interacts with gender-biased parental investments to shape long-run cognitive performance. Using nationally representative survey data from China, we show that fetal PM2.5 exposure significantly reduces cognitive ability for women, particularly among those with brothers. Our evidence suggests that the family investment channel operates primarily through education rather than health, with gender-biased educational resource allocation compounding negative outcomes for females. Specifically, conditional on the same level of fetal PM2.5 exposure, females receive less homework assistance from their families and attain lower levels of education.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了产前空气污染暴露如何与性别偏见的父母投资相互作用，从而影响长期认知表现。利用中国全国代表性调查数据，我们发现胎儿期PM2.5暴露显著降低女性的认知能力，尤其是有兄弟的女性。证据表明，家庭投资渠道主要通过教育而非健康发挥作用，性别偏见的教育资源分配加剧了女性的负面结果。具体而言，在胎儿期PM2.5暴露水平相同的情况下，女性从家庭获得的作业辅导较少，教育程度也较低。

title: Endogenous Altruism and Long Term Care Policies in a Mirrleesian Setting
title_zh: 内生的利他主义与Mirrleesian框架下的长期护理政策
title_primary: 内生的利他主义与Mirrleesian框架下的长期护理政策
title_secondary: Endogenous Altruism and Long Term Care Policies in a Mirrleesian Setting
authors: Cremer, Helmuth, Gahvari, Firouz
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study contributes to the long-term care policy literature by exploring how, in an uncertain environment, redistributive tax policies and long-term care program design interact with informal care incentives, shaping long-term caregiving outcomes. The analysis is done within an overlapping-generations model in the steady state under full and asymetric information. Altruistic children provide informal care to their elderly parents if dependent. Not all children are altruistic. Children
abstract_zh: 本研究通过探讨在不确定环境下，再分配税收政策与长期护理项目设计如何与家庭非正式照护激励相互作用，从而影响长期照护结果，为长期护理政策文献做出贡献。分析在重叠世代模型的稳态下进行，涵盖完全信息与不对称信息两种情形。利他主义的子女在父母失能时提供非正式照护，但并非所有子女都具有利他倾向。

title: Political Polarization and Human Capital Allocation
title_zh: 政治极化与人力资本配置
title_primary: 政治极化与人力资本配置
title_secondary: Political Polarization and Human Capital Allocation
authors: David Martinez-Miera, Carlos Sunyer
official: 官方在线 2025-09-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence on the negative effects of political polarization on human capital allocation and hospital outcomes. Levering Spain’s centralized rank-based system for allocating recently graduated doctors to hospitals, we obtain (i) a precise measure of each doctor’s quality and (ii) their work-location choices. Exploiting a plausibly exogenous increase in political polarization in a Spanish region, we find that polarization reduces the average quality of incoming doctors, as higher-ranked candidates become less likely to select positions in the affected region. Examining the underlying mechanisms, we find evidence consistent with conflict avoidance rather than ideological sorting. Consistent with the documented decrease in doctors’ quality, we document an increase in risk-adjusted in-hospital mortality rates. Our findings highlight the broader economic and social costs of political polarization, particularly its impact on the distribution of skilled professionals and health.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于政治极化对人力资本配置和医院结果负面影响的实证证据。利用西班牙基于中央排名的系统，将新毕业医生分配到各医院，我们获得了（i）每位医生质量的精确度量及（ii）其工作地点选择。利用西班牙某地区政治极化程度看似外生的增加，我们发现极化降低了新进医生的平均质量，因为排名较高的候选人选择受影响地区职位的可能性降低。在考察潜在机制时，我们发现了与冲突规避而非意识形态分类相一致的证据。与所记录的医生质量下降相一致，我们观察到风险调整后院内死亡率的上升。我们的发现凸显了政治极化更广泛的经济和社会成本，特别是其对熟练专业人员分布和健康的影响。

title: The Economic Consequences of Insecure Property Rights
title_zh: 产权不安全的经济后果
title_primary: 产权不安全的经济后果
title_secondary: The Economic Consequences of Insecure Property Rights
authors: Yehonatan Givati & Oren Rigbi
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Secure property rights support efficient allocation and investment, yet their effects in affluent urban markets remain understudied. We examine Jerusalem properties built on church-owned land under 99-year leases approaching expiration, creating substantial legal and political uncertainty. Using all residential transactions from 2004–2024, we compare nearby properties with secure and insecure rights within the same blocks. Insecure rights reduce transaction likelihood by about 20 percent and prices by 10–15 percent on average, revealing large costs of legal uncertainty. A present-value framework implies that market participants assign a substantial, but far from certain, probability to losing rights.
abstract_zh: 稳定的产权有助于资源的有效配置和投资，然而其在富裕城市市场中的影响尚未得到充分研究。我们考察了耶路撒冷建于教会所有土地上的房产，这些房产的99年租约即将到期，由此产生了重大的法律和政治不确定性。利用2004年至2024年的所有住宅交易数据，我们比较了同一街区内产权安全与不安全的邻近房产。不安全的产权使交易可能性平均降低约20%，价格下降10%至15%，揭示了法律不确定性的巨大成本。一个现值框架表明，市场参与者对失去产权的可能性赋予了显著但远非确定的概率。

title: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
title_zh: 碳食品标签对杂货购物行为影响有限：来自随机实验的证据
title_primary: 碳食品标签对杂货购物行为影响有限：来自随机实验的证据
title_secondary: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
authors: Maiken Maier, Lukas Paul Fesenfeld
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Demand-side food policies are increasingly recognized as important tools for aligning consumption patterns with climate change mitigation targets, and carbon food labels have attracted growing attention as a potential policy instrument. However, evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed, and causal evaluation results from assessing the effects of carbon food labels in real-world supermarket settings is scarce. This study presents evidence from pre-registered randomized field-embedded survey experiment with behavioral outcomes, combining a representative sample of 2,372 Swiss residents with transaction-level purchasing data covering more than five million daily food purchase decisions made by 1,601 consumers over several years. In collaboration with one of Switzerland’s largest grocery retailers, we evaluate the causal impact of an information treatment designed to increase awareness of one of the world’s first carbon food labels implemented in grocery stores on both stated preferences and revealed purchasing behavior. The results show that the information treatment significantly increases label awareness and leads to small but positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioral control, and intentions to consider the climate compatibility of food purchases. When tracing these effects into revealed purchasing behavior, the treatment also affects actual food purchases, but effects are modest and heterogeneous across food categories. Rather than inducing broad shifts away from meat consumption, the information treatment primarily leads to a higher overall share of labeled products purchased, increased purchases of labeled convenience products, and a partial reallocation within meat consumption (e.g., lower beef and higher pork purchases). We find no evidence of substantial reductions in overall meat purchases or large cross-category substitutions toward plant-based foods. While heavy meat eaters do not react negatively to the treatment, men and more right-wing individuals show a modest behavioral backlash. Overall, the results suggest that carbon food labels capacity to substantially alter habitual food consumption patterns in stimulus-intensive retail environments is limited and should be thus complemented by additional demand-side measures.
abstract_zh: 需求侧食品政策日益被认为是使消费模式与气候变化减缓目标相一致的重要工具，碳食品标签作为一种潜在的政策手段也引起了越来越多的关注。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然不一，且在真实超市环境中评估碳食品标签影响的因果评价结果十分稀缺。本研究提供了来自预注册的随机实地嵌入调查实验的证据，并结合行为结果，涵盖了2，372名瑞士居民的代表性样本，以及包含1，601名消费者多年间超过五百万次日常食品购买决策的交易级购买数据。我们与瑞士最大的杂货零售商之一合作，评估了一项旨在提高对杂货店中全球首批碳食品标签之一认知度的信息干预对陈述偏好和揭示性购买行为的因果影响。结果显示，信息干预显著提高了标签认知度，并对态度、感知行为控制以及考虑食品购买气候兼容性的意图产生了虽小但积极的影响。在将这些影响追踪至揭示性购买行为时，干预也影响了实际食品购买，但效果温和且在不同食品类别间存在异质性。信息干预并未引发远离肉类消费的广泛转变，而是主要导致所购标签产品总体份额增加、标签便利产品购买量上升，以及肉类消费内部的部分重新分配（例如，牛肉购买减少而猪肉购买增加）。我们未发现总体肉类购买量大幅减少或向植物基食品大规模跨类别替代的证据。尽管重度肉类消费者对干预未表现出负面反应，但男性和更倾向右翼的个体表现出适度的行为反弹。总体而言，结果表明，在刺激密集的零售环境中，碳食品标签显著改变习惯性食品消费模式的能力有限，因此应辅以额外的需求侧措施。

title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
title_zh: 行为政策的价值
title_primary: 行为政策的价值
title_secondary: The Value of Behavioral Policies
authors: John A. List, Matthias Rodemeier, Sutanuka Roy, Gregory K. Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing “nudges” and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.

abstract: This paper reviews firm-level data on artificial intelligence and the emerging evidence on AI's economic effects. It argues that measurement is central: different AI datasets capture different objects (including invention versus use, internal capability building versus outsourcing, and realized activity versus investor perceptions) and can therefore lead to different conclusions. The paper develops a framework for choosing among these measures and surveys available data sources on firm AI efforts. It synthesizes evidence on AI's effects on firm growth, valuation, productivity, risk, labor, competition, financial markets and applications. The paper concludes by suggesting some ideas for future research.

abstract: This Paper considers the implications of incomplete exchange rate pass-through for optimal monetary and exchange rate policy. A two-country model is presented which allows an explicit derivation of welfare functions in terms of a weighted sum of the second moments of producer prices and the nominal exchange rate. From a single country perspective the optimal exchange rate variance depends on the degree of pass-through, the size and openness of the economy, the elasticity of labour supply and the volatility of foreign producer prices. The optimal coordinated equilibrium can be supported by requiring national central banks to minimize loss functions, which are a weighted sum of the variances of producer prices and the exchange rate, where the weight on the exchange rate variance depends on the degree of pass-through.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不完全汇率传递对最优货币与汇率政策的含义。通过构建两国模型，以生产者价格与名义汇率的二阶矩加权和形式明确推导出福利函数。从单一国家视角来看，最优汇率方差取决于汇率传递程度、经济体规模与开放度、劳动供给弹性以及外国生产者价格的波动性。最优协调均衡可通过要求各国央行最小化损失函数来实现，该损失函数由生产者价格方差与汇率方差的加权和构成，其中汇率方差的权重取决于汇率传递程度。

official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: A consequence of Mendel’s First Law is that siblings' genetic relatedness varies randomly (with a mean of 50%). We use molecular genetic data to compute the genetic relatedness of ~80,000 sib pairs. We then compare the pairs' genetic relatedness to their similarity on 15 socioeconomic and health outcomes to estimate the relative importance of genetic (i.e., heritability) and family environmental influences on each outcome. We find evidence of sizeable genetic influences on many outcomes, including cognitive performance, fertility, risk tolerance, smoking, and subjective wellbeing, and of more limited genetic influences on educational attainment and income.
abstract_zh: 孟德尔第一定律的一个推论是，兄弟姐妹的遗传相关性随机变化（平均值为50%）。我们利用分子遗传学数据计算了约8万对兄弟姐妹的遗传相关性，随后比较这些配对在15项社会经济与健康结果上的相似性，以估算遗传（即遗传力）和家庭环境因素对每项结果的相对重要性。研究发现，许多结果（包括认知表现、生育能力、风险承受力、吸烟行为及主观幸福感）受到显著的遗传影响，而教育成就和收入受遗传影响的程度则较为有限。

authors: Javier López Prol
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Corporate climate mitigation targets are increasingly relevant, but ambition measurement remains inconsistent. Linear annual reduction (LAR) and compound annual reduction (CAR) are common measures of climate ambition, but they imply different reduction paths and may reverse ambition rankings when percentage reductions and target horizons differ. I derive the exact pairwise ranking-reversal condition, revealing that LAR favors shorter, shallower targets compared to CAR, and apply this framework to the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) Target Dashboard. The results confirm substantial ranking reversal depending on whether LAR or CAR is used to define ambition.
abstract_zh: 企业气候减缓目标日益重要，但雄心衡量标准仍不一致。线性年度减排（LAR）和复合年度减排（CAR）是衡量气候雄心的常用指标，但它们隐含不同的减排路径，且在百分比减排量和目标期限不同时，可能导致雄心排名发生逆转。我推导出精确的成对排名逆转条件，揭示LAR相较于CAR更偏好较短、较浅的目标，并将此框架应用于科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）目标仪表板。结果证实，根据使用LAR还是CAR来定义雄心，排名逆转现象显著存在。

title: Does public data openness curb insider trading? Evidence from China
title_zh: 公共数据开放是否抑制了内幕交易？来自中国的证据

authors: Dixin Wu, Juerui Feng, Lili Jiu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines whether public data openness affects insider trading behaviour and profitability. Utilizing China’s staggered municipal launch of open government data (OGD) platforms and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that public data openness reduces insider trading profitability. Mechanism tests reveal that OGD platforms operate through an information channel by enriching the firm-level information environment, specifically increasing analyst coverage, narrowing bid-ask spreads, and reducing stock price synchronicity. Further analyses show that OGD platforms compress insider trading on both the extensive margin (reducing overall trading likelihood) and the intensive margin (lowering the probability of trade success conditional on trading). Cross-sectional tests show that this deterrent effect is more pronounced for firms with weaker corporate governance and those located in regions with superior digital infrastructure. These findings offer insights for policymakers that public data infrastructure generates positive externalities for financial market integrity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察公共数据开放是否影响内幕交易行为及其盈利性。利用中国各城市分阶段启动政府数据开放平台的自然实验，结合堆叠双重差分模型，我们发现公共数据开放降低了内幕交易盈利水平。机制检验表明，政府数据开放平台通过信息渠道发挥作用——通过丰富企业层面的信息环境，具体表现为增加分析师关注度、缩小买卖价差以及降低股价同步性。进一步分析显示，政府数据开放平台从广延边际（降低整体交易可能性）和集约边际（降低既定交易条件下的成功概率）两个维度压缩内幕交易。截面检验表明，这种抑制效应在公司治理较弱的企业以及位于数字基础设施更优地区的企业中更为显著。这些发现为政策制定者提供了启示：公共数据基础设施能够为金融市场诚信建设产生正向外部性。

abstract: We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of twin defaults : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在一个银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险的量化一般均衡模型中，研究了最优资本要求。与标准的银行违约风险模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了贷款组合收益的有限上行空间和显著下行风险。这有助于再现双重违约（即企业与银行同时出现高违约率）的频率与严重程度。因此，最优银行资本要求在降低双重违约频率与限制信贷供给之间进行权衡，其水平高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型所得到的结果。

title: Targeting Attitudes to Combat Sexual Harassment: A Randomized Intervention in the Norwegian Military

abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers' beliefs that "telling sexualized jokes can be labeled sexual harassment" and about women soldiers' equal performance on military skill tests. This treatment gives lasting improvements in knowledge about what sexual harassment is and about women's job performance. The impact on sexual harassment prevalence is directionally negative but statistically insignificant. We discuss measurement error and use survey responses about a harassment scenario to argue that the intervention likely affected behavior. Our study provides the first field experiment to evaluate whether a prevention method against sexual harassment reduces prevalence in a work setting. We use insights from our research process to identify methodological pitfalls and provide guidance for future field experiments in this area.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小规模新兵群体中通过随机对照试验进行了测试。该干预措施旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的认知差距。我们向部分新兵告知其同伴认为“讲黄色笑话可被视为性骚扰”的观点，以及女兵在军事技能测试中表现同样出色的信息。这一干预措施显著提升了受试者对性骚扰定义及女性工作表现的认知，且效果具有持续性。干预对性骚扰发生率的影响呈负向趋势，但未达到统计显著性。我们讨论了测量误差问题，并利用关于骚扰情境的问卷调查结果论证该干预措施可能影响了实际行为。本研究提供了首个通过实地实验评估工作场所性骚扰预防措施有效性的证据。我们基于研究过程中的洞察识别了方法论陷阱，并为该领域未来的实地实验提供了指导建议。

title: Work Under Attack: Terrorism and Local Labor Markets
title_zh: 遭受攻击下的工作：恐怖主义与地方劳动力市场
title_primary: 遭受攻击下的工作：恐怖主义与地方劳动力市场

authors: Olayinka Oyekola
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。恐怖袭击暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规就业和现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全局势的重要经济代价。

title: Profit Margin Protection Program Participation by US Dairy Farmers
title_primary: Profit Margin Protection Program Participation by US Dairy Farmers
authors: Weir, Rebecca L., Wolf, Christopher A., Hadrich, Joleen C.
source: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The U.S. dairy farm industry is subject to milk and feed price volatility. The Dairy Margin Coverage (DMC) program, and its predecessor, the Margin Protection Program for Dairy (MPP), are federal risk management programs for dairy producers that account for input (feed) and output (milk) prices. Under these programs, farmers receive payments based on the national margin between the U.S. All-Milk price and a national feed cost. We use a fractional logit regression to estimate factors associated with farm DMC/MPP participation. Results indicate that positive expected payouts led to higher participation while the presence of an Amish population decreased participation.

title: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
title_zh: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处
title_primary: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处
title_secondary: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
authors: Marco Lambrecht, Joerg Oechssler, Simon Weidenholzer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Robo-advisors are tools in financial markets that provide investors with low-cost financial advice, typically based on individual characteristics such as risk attitudes. We study the benefits of robo-advice in a ten-week portfolio choice experiment. Depending on treatment, investors either receive robo-advice, have a robo-advisor implement recommendations by default, or invest on their own. While we observe no effect of robo-advice on initial market participation, we find positive effects on continued participation. Robo-advisors also help investors avoid mistakes, increase rebalancing, and yield portfolios closer to the utility-maximising benchmark. Default implementation of recommendations performs significantly better than advice alone.
abstract_zh: 机器人投顾是金融市场中为投资者提供低成本财务建议的工具，通常基于风险态度等个人特征。我们通过一项为期十周的投资组合选择实验，研究了机器人投顾的益处。根据实验处理方式的不同，投资者或接受机器人投顾建议，或由机器人投顾默认执行推荐方案，或自行投资。虽然我们未观察到机器人投顾对初始市场参与的影响，但发现其对持续参与具有积极效应。机器人投顾还能帮助投资者避免错误、增加再平衡操作，并使投资组合更接近效用最大化的基准水平。相较于仅提供建议，默认执行推荐方案的效果显著更优。

title: Household debt, the labor share, and earnings inequality
title_zh: 家庭债务、劳动收入份额与收入不平等
title_primary: 家庭债务、劳动收入份额与收入不平等
title_secondary: Household debt, the labor share, and earnings inequality
authors: Mark Robinson, Pedro Silos, Diego Vilán
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that the secular decline in real interest rates in the United States, which began in the early 1980s and persisted for nearly four decades, reduced the labor’s share of output and the unemployment rate, and increased earnings inequality. We establish this link using a model of frictional labor markets, estimated from household-level data, in which unemployment risk is only partially insurable. Rising debt resulting from lower interest rates reduces the value of unemployment, leading to lower equilibrium wages relative to productivity and a lower unemployment rate. Wage dispersion also rises. The model is consistent with panel-data reduced-form evidence linking unemployment duration, assets, debt, and post-unemployment wages. In the model, a decline in the real interest rate of the magnitude observed in the data generates a decline in the labor’s share of 6 percentage points and in the unemployment rate of 0.3 percentage points. The variance of log earnings rises from 0.66 to 0.75.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国实际利率自20世纪80年代初开始的长期下降趋势，持续近四十年，降低了劳动收入份额和失业率，并加剧了收入不平等。我们通过一个基于摩擦性劳动力市场的模型建立了这一联系，该模型利用家庭层面数据估计，其中失业风险仅能部分保险。由较低利率导致的债务增加降低了失业的价值，从而相对于生产率降低了均衡工资，并降低了失业率。工资离散度也随之上升。该模型与面板数据简化形式证据一致，这些证据将失业持续时间、资产、债务及失业后工资联系起来。在模型中，实际利率下降幅度与数据中观察到的相当，导致劳动收入份额下降6个百分点，失业率下降0.3个百分点。对数收入方差从0.66上升至0.75。

title: From Penalization to Over-Parameterization: Achieving Implicit Regularization for High-Dimensional Linear Errors-in-Variables Models
title_primary: From Penalization to Over-Parameterization: Achieving Implicit Regularization for High-Dimensional Linear Errors-in-Variables Models
authors: Jingxuan Luo, Yinfei Kong, Gaorong Li
official: 官方在线 2026-02-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Regularization methods are crucial for the analysis of high-dimensional data, with most methods adding a penalty term to the loss function explicitly. In this paper, we introduce an implicit regularization technique through over-parameterization and propose a calibrated penalty-free (CPF) estimation method for high-dimensional linear errors-in-variables models. This method calibrates the bias caused by measurement errors while avoiding the bias introduced by penalty terms. We use the gradient descent algorithm to minimize the over-parameterized calibrated loss function without penalties, resulting in a sparse estimate of regression coefficients and thus achieving implicit regularization. Furthermore, a novel bootstrap methodology is introduced to address the challenge posed by the unknown covariance matrix of measurement errors. The oracle inequality for estimation error is established under certain regularity conditions. Extensive simulation studies and a real data analysis illustrate the competitive finite sample performance of the proposed method.

title: Opioid Crisis and Real Estate Prices
title_zh: 阿片危机与房地产价格
title_primary: 阿片危机与房地产价格
title_secondary: Opioid Crisis and Real Estate Prices
authors: Custódio, Cláudia, Cvijanović, Dragana, Wiedemann, Moritz
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
official: 官方在线 2025-10-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the impact of opioid abuse on real estate prices. We document that opioid death rates and excess prescription rates are negatively associated with house prices. Exploiting the staggered passage of opioid-limiting legislation, we find that a decrease in opioid abuse results in higher county-level house prices. This effect is due to fewer mortgage delinquencies, lower vacancy rates, more home improvement loans, and increased population inflow. Our findings are consistent with improved real estate conditions and a rise in local demand. These results highlight the importance of public health policy in mitigating the economic costs of the opioid epidemic.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了阿片类药物滥用对房地产价格的影响。我们发现，阿片类药物致死率和过量处方率与房价呈负相关。利用阿片类药物限制性立法的分阶段实施，我们发现阿片类药物滥用的减少导致县级房价上升。这一效应归因于抵押贷款违约减少、空置率下降、房屋改善贷款增加以及人口流入增多。我们的研究结果与房地产状况改善及本地需求上升相一致。这些发现凸显了公共卫生政策在减轻阿片类药物流行病经济成本方面的重要性。

title: Dynamic agency and investment theory with model ambiguity
title_zh: 模型模糊性下的动态代理与投资理论
title_primary: 模型模糊性下的动态代理与投资理论
title_secondary: Dynamic agency and investment theory with model ambiguity
authors: Ying Wang Wenli Huang Wenqiong Liu a School of Finance, Nanjing University of Finance and Economics, Nanjing, Jiangsu, Chinab School of Finance, Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, Chinac School of Economics and Management 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how ambiguity in the production process and exogenous shocks affect contractual outcomes by incorporating these factors into a principal-agent model. The principal adopts distinct strategies in response to each type of ambiguity. When ambiguity in production process increases, the principal reduces investment, shares ambiguity exposure with the agent, and delays payment to strengthen bargaining power position. In contrast, when facing exogenous shocks beyond the agent’s control, the principal mitigates firm internal risk and enhances stability by reducing capital investment in the risky production process, providing advance payments, and avoiding payoff reductions to preserve the agent’s incentives during shocks. These strategies emerge from the interaction between ambiguity and incentive design within the contracting framework. Notably, both types of ambiguity lose relevance under liquidation pressure, and production process ambiguity becomes insignificant when output is sufficiently high.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将生产过程中的模糊性与外生冲击纳入委托-代理模型，探讨了这两类因素如何影响契约结果。委托人针对每种模糊性采取不同的应对策略。当生产过程模糊性增加时，委托人减少投资，与代理人分担模糊性风险，并延迟支付以增强议价地位。相反，当面临超出代理人控制的外生冲击时，委托人通过减少对高风险生产过程的资本投入、提供预付款以及避免削减报酬来维持代理人在冲击期间的激励，从而降低企业内部风险并增强稳定性。这些策略源于契约框架内模糊性与激励设计之间的相互作用。值得注意的是，在清算压力下，两类模糊性均失去相关性；而当产出足够高时，生产过程模糊性变得不再显著。

title: Information consumption and enterprise digital transformation: evidence from China’s pilot policy
title_zh: 信息消费与企业数字化转型：来自中国试点政策的证据
title_primary: 信息消费与企业数字化转型：来自中国试点政策的证据
title_secondary: Information consumption and enterprise digital transformation: evidence from China’s pilot policy
authors: Yang Wang, Ling Guo
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the impact of China’s Information Consumption Pilot (ICP) policy on enterprises’ digital transformation (DT) using firm-level panel data of Chinese listed companies from 2009 to 2023. Employing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we find that the ICP significantly promotes firms’ DT, particularly in foundational digital technology adoption. The effect is more pronounced in high-consumption regions, among non-politically connected enterprises, larger firms and those operating in high-tech industries. The mechanism analysis reveals that, on the demand side, the ICP increases media digital attention, which indirectly accelerates DT by shaping consumer expectations and digital awareness. On the supply side, the ICP enhances digital infrastructure, provides digital subsidies, and promotes the aggregation of digital talent, jointly strengthening firms’ capacity for DT. Furthermore, we find that the ICP significantly enhances firms’ total factor productivity (TFP), indicating broader economic benefits beyond DT. Our findings offer new insights into digital policy design and enterprise transformation strategies in emerging economies.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009至2023年中国上市公司企业层面的面板数据，考察了信息消费试点政策对企业数字化转型的影响。采用多期双重差分法，我们发现信息消费试点显著促进了企业的数字化转型，尤其是在基础数字技术采纳方面。这一效应在消费水平较高的地区、非政治关联企业、规模较大的企业以及高科技行业的企业中更为显著。机制分析揭示，在需求侧，信息消费试点增加了媒体数字关注度，通过塑造消费者预期和数字意识间接加速了数字化转型；在供给侧，信息消费试点强化了数字基础设施，提供了数字补贴，并促进了数字人才的集聚，共同增强了企业数字化转型的能力。此外，我们还发现信息消费试点显著提升了企业的全要素生产率，表明其带来的经济效益超越了数字化转型本身。我们的研究为新兴经济体的数字政策设计与企业转型策略提供了新的洞见。

title: Physical climate risks and investment behaviour, the role of cultural differences
title_zh: 物理气候风险与投资行为：文化差异的作用
title_primary: 物理气候风险与投资行为：文化差异的作用
title_secondary: Physical climate risks and investment behaviour, the role of cultural differences
authors: Adam Arian Ramona Zharfpeykan Richard Busulwa a Peter Faber Business School, Australian Catholic University, Brisbane, Australiab University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland, Auckland, New Zealandc School of Business Law and Entrepreneurship 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This research explores the impact of severe physical climate risks on corporate investment decisions and outcomes, focusing on the role of cultural differences in shaping this relationship among emerging economies. Using a sample of 308,451 firm-year observations across 51 countries covering 2007 to 2019, we find that physical climate risks significantly reduce investment efficiency. Our analyses of cultural differences show that firms in hierarchical cultures adopt more conservative investment approaches, limiting adaptability to climate challenges, while firms in risk-averse cultures proactively integrate climate risks, leading to better investment efficiency. A difference-in-differences analysis further shows that the Paris Agreement led to modest short-term improvements in climate-related investment responses, though longer-term challenges remain. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating cultural context into policy and corporate governance strategies to enhance climate resilience. For robustness, we use System-GMM estimation, helping to account for potential endogeneity and dynamic firm-level factors.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了严重物理气候风险对企业投资决策及结果的影响，并聚焦于文化差异在塑造新兴经济体这一关系中的作用。基于2007年至2019年间覆盖51个国家的308,451个公司-年度观测样本，我们发现物理气候风险显著降低了投资效率。对文化差异的分析表明，在层级文化中的企业采取更为保守的投资策略，限制了对气候挑战的适应能力，而在风险规避文化中的企业则主动整合气候风险，从而实现更高的投资效率。一项双重差分分析进一步显示，《巴黎协定》在短期内带来了气候相关投资反应的适度改善，但长期挑战依然存在。这些发现强调了将文化背景纳入政策和公司治理策略以增强气候韧性的重要性。为稳健性考虑，我们采用系统GMM估计方法，以帮助应对潜在的内生性和动态企业层面因素。

title: Cultural doorways in the barriers to development
title_zh: 发展障碍中的文化通道
title_primary: 发展障碍中的文化通道
title_secondary: Cultural doorways in the barriers to development
authors: Marcello D’Amato, Francesco Flaviano Russo
official: 官方在线 2025-04-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop novel indices of cultural similarity among ethnic groups derived from their oral traditions. We find that variation in these indices significantly affects currently observed pairwise disparities in income per capita, even after controlling for measures of geo-climatic, historical, religious, and linguistic barriers. We also propose an empirical exploration of the mechanisms linking folklore similarities to income differences. These findings lend support to the relevance of knowledge, information and technological transfers across people and societies in the diffusion of development.
abstract_zh: 我们基于各民族口头传统构建了文化相似性的新指数。研究发现，这些指数的差异显著影响当前观察到的两两之间的人均收入差距，即便在控制了地理气候、历史、宗教及语言障碍等因素后依然如此。我们还提出了一种实证探索，用以考察民俗相似性与收入差异之间的关联机制。这些发现支持了知识、信息和技术在人群与社会间传播对发展扩散的重要性。
